name: wetland
job: Map open water on every NISAR Pass across the delta, through cloud and day or night
user: Wetland managers and water authorities tracking the yearly flood pulse

labels.source: Sentinel-2 water index (MNDWI > 0) within 4 days of the Passes 2026-07-08, 2026-09-06, 2026-10-24
labels.notes: Optical labels miss water under vegetation and count it as dry land

baseline.name: Otsu threshold on HH, per Pass

model.name: LightGBM on per-Pass backscatter and season statistics

split: Spatial 5-fold cross-validation over 5 km blocks, label dates pooled; water and land sampled about equally
limits: Open water only: water under reeds and papyrus (flooded vegetation) is not learned, because optical labels cannot see it
Wind-roughened water is bright and can be missed
Scores use balanced samples; on the whole delta, where water is rarer, IoU is lower
